name: Adrenaline Warboots
effect: The wearer gains +(wearer's PER bonus x 2)% dodge against enemies under the effect of Expose Weakness.

name: Astral Currents
effect:
The wearer gains +20 MP in the first round of combat. Their movement cost is not reduced by threatening areas.
Also, the wearer's movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity during this round.

name: Battle-Psyker Boots
effect: The wearer gains PER bonus% dodge until the start of their next turn for each enemy affected by their psy-power or psyker staff attack. Stacks.

name: Blitz Boots
effect: The wearer gains a +4 bonus to damage against enemies who have no adjacent allies. The range of the wearer's Dash and Charge abilities is increased by +1 cell.

name: Boots of Victory
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a heroic act, they recover all their wounds and gain +2 AP this turn.

name: Breezecatcher Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer moves through a cell occupied by an enemy, the wearer gains +15% dodge against that enemy's attacks until the wearer's next turn.

name: Bruiser Boots
effect:
Whenever the wearer performs an area attack, they instantly provoke attacks of opportunity from all adjacent enemies.
The wearer gains +TGH bonus temporary wounds for each attack of opportunity provoked by an area attack.

name: Cursed Boots
effect:
Whenever the wearer ends their turn, they deal 1 warp damage to each adjacent creature and to the wearer themselves.
The wearer also deals an additional +Conviction - Heretical rank warp damage to enemies.

name: Death World Warboots
effect: These boots grant their wearer a +15% dodge reduction bonus for attacks with melee weapons.

name: Disciple's Boots
effect: The wearer gains + (wearer's PER bonus x2)% dodge against enemies under the effect of Expose Weakness.

name: Dynamo Boots
effect: Increase the wearers' movement points by +3.

name: Enforcer Corrupted Boots
effect:
Requires Heretical--Votary
The wearer is always slowed but immune to the immobilised effect.
Targets hit by the wearer's melee attacks fall prone for 1 turn if they fail a Toughness resistance test with a -(5 x Heretical rank) penalty. If passed, the target becomes slowed for 1 turn instead.

name: Ergo Boots
effect: Increase the wearer's Agility by +5 and Athetics by +10.

name: Expeditionary Footwear
effect: Whenever the wearer uses a Navigator power, the again +15% dodge until the end of the round. Stacks.

name: Hungering Mind
effect: The power of burning effects inflicted by the wearer is increased by +1 for each enemy affected by the wearer's area attacks until the end of combat. This bonus stacks.

name: Intendant Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer uses a consumable item, they gain +2 MP and +20% dodge until the start of their next turn.

name: Lightweight Boots
effect: The wearer of these boots gains +STR bonus % parry while wearing a light amour.

name: Pneumo Boots
effect: Using the Charge ability costs -1 AP less.

name: Psyker's Footwear
effect: These boots grant their wearer +3% dodge until the end of combat for each psy power they use. Stacks.

name: Pyromanic Boots
effect:
The wearer can't suffer the burning effect by walking over the burning cells.
The wearer inflicts +3 additional stacks of burning whenever they stand on burning cells.

name: Recoil Warboots
effect:
Whenever the wearer attacks an enemy behind cover with a ranged attack, cover efficiency is decreased by -40% for that attack.
-15 recoil

name: Rallying Boots
effect: After the wearer uses Following!, the wearer's allies gain a +33% bonus to damage on their next attack for each ally within a 2-cell radius from the wearer.

name: Sharpshooter Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a single-shot ranged attack from any cover, this attack gains +(Awareness)/4) armour penetration.

name: Spiked Boots
effect:
At the start of the combat, the wearer inflicts bleeding (5) on themselves. Whenever the wearer performs an area melee attack, they inflict bleeding (3) on all hit creatures.
This area melee attack also deals +(5 x wearer's bleeding level)(% additional damage.

name: Sororitas Boots
effect: The wearer raises momentum to 175 whenever they kill 5 enemies in a row in one turn.

name: Stalking Boots
effect: If the wearer has melee weapons equipped in both hands, their Slash ability makes an additional melee attack with the secondary weapon.

name: Stalwart Boots
effect: The wearer and adjacent allies cannot fall prone and become immune to forced movement effects.

name: Unyielding Vanguard Boots
effect: All allies in a 2-cell radius around the wearer gain a +40% bonus to resolve from the Unyielding Beacon ability instead of the original bonus.

name: Warmonger Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer kills 2 or more enemies with a single attack, the attack doesn't spend all of the wearer's MP.

name: Acrobat's Greaves
effect: At the start of combat, the wearer gains stacks of acrobatic trick equal to their MP. These stacks can be used until the end of combat.

name: Arch-Militant's Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a melee attack after a ranged attack, the target of the melee attack should pass a Toughness resistance test with a -15 penalty or get knocked prone.

name: Astartes Power Boots
effect: The Kick ability costs 0 AP and deals an additional XX damage.

name: Bladed Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer hits an opening with the Charge, Slash, or Danse Macabre abilities, they inflict bleeding (10) on the target.

name: Bladedancer's Greaves
effect: Moving through cells affected by Raining Blood or blood phial costs the wearer -50% MP less.

name: Bladedancer's Light Greaves
effect: Moving through cells affected by Raining Blood or blood phial costs the wearer 0 MP.

name: Boots of Decay
effect: Each time the wearer uses a major psychic power, all enemies in their line of sight lose 30% of their deflection until the start of the wearer's next turn.

name: Boots of Kasrkin
effect: When in cover, the wearer has 100% cover efficiency against area attacks but never dodges them. Also, they suffer -50% less damage from area attacks. Whenever the wearer uses a grenade and it hits at least 3 enemies at once for the first time in combat, this action does not spend AP.

name: Breacher Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer's area attack damages at least two enemies within a 2-cell radius from the wearer the wearer gains the Kick ability costing 0 AP to use until the end of their turn.

name: Caligae of Saint Keefe
effect: Whenever the wearer performs a heroic act or a desperate measure, they recover all their wounds and gain +2 AP this turn.

name: Chirurgeon's Boots
effect: At the beginning of combat, the wearer gets the Medikit and Onslaught abilities, which reproduce the effect of the medikit and onslaught consumables, costing 0 AP. Each of these abilities can only be used once per combat.

name: Commissar Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer chooses an ally as the target of their ability, the wearer immediately gains +XX MP. The targeted ally gains +XX MP at the start of this ally's next turn.

name: Dancing on Blood
effect: Once per turn, after the wearer uses Blood Oath or Oath of Vengeance, they gain +1 use of Dash, costing 0 AP, until the end of their turn. After using this Dash ability. the wearer regains MP equal to their resolve.

name: Deadly Dancer Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer's MP reach 0, the wearer deals XX impact damage to all adjacent enemies.

name: Defensive Boots
effect: If the wearer did not spend MP during their turn, they double their cover efficiency in half-cover until the end of the wearer's next turn.

name: Enforcer Light Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer parries an attack, they immediately strike back at the attacker. If this attack deals damage, the wearer performs Kick to push the enemy away.

name: Fencing Boots
effect: The wearer gains +XX% parry when using swords. Whenever the wearer parries with a sword, they immediately counter attack, causing the attacking enemy to become staggered. If the attacker is staggered, the wearer's parry is increased by +XX%.

name: Freerunner Boots
effect: The wearer becomes immune to the slowed and immobilised effects.

name: Greaves of the Black Archon
effect: Every time the wearer scores a critical hit with a melee weapon, they restore (Agility bonus / 2) wounds and gain +2 MP. +15% critical damage.

name: Heavy Breacher's Boots
effect: After the wearer makes an area attack, they gain +4 MP and can continue their movement.

name: Improved Lightweight Boots
effect: The wearer of these boots gains +XX% parry and re-rolls failed dodge tests.

name: Martyr Boots
effect: The wearer can move through cells adjacent to enemies spending the normal amount of movement points. Also, the wearer gains momentum equal to their resolve each time they suffer damage from attacks of opportunity.

name: Navy Breacher Boots
effect: When the wearer's area attack damages at least two enemies within a 2-cell radius from the wearer for the first time during the round, the wearer gains +2 AP, and this attack does not count toward their attack limit. The wearer then becomes immobilised until the start of their next turn.

name: Pyromaniac Boots
effect: The wearer cannot suffer the burning effect by walking over burning cells. The wearer inflicts +3 additional stacks of burning whenever they stand on burning cells.

name: Reinforced Boots
effect: These boots grant their wearer +5 Toughness. Collision damage caused by the wearer is increased by +XX.

name: Skirmisher Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer deals damage to an enemy, the wearer has a 25% chance to gain 2 MP.

name: Swift Shadows
effect: Once per turn, after the wearer uses Blood Oath or Oath of Vengeance, they gain +1 use of Dash, costing 0 AP, until the end of their turn.

name: Tactical Boots
effect: Whenever an enemy attempts to make an attack of opportunity against the wearer, that enemy is pushed back by 1 cell before the attack is able to hit the wearer.

name: Tracking Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer's Hot on the Trail extra turn is triggered, the wearer gains + 1 AP and +AGI bonus MP for this extra turn.

name: Void Veteran Boots
effect: Whenever the wearer kills an enemy with their melee attack, they immediately gain +1 use of Charge costing 0 AP (even if they do not have this ability).

name: Wear-Resistant Boots
effect: Grant +5 Agility and +XX% dodge against attacks of opportunity.

name: Windrunner Boots
effect: Whenever an enemy moves to a cell adjacent to the wearer for the first time in round, the wearer immediately gains an extra turn with 3 MP and 0 AP. The wearer does not provoke attacks of opportunity during this turn.
